## Checklist

- [ ] The install line comes from the plugin's own page on `cursor.com/marketplace`, or from a real install path I followed
- [ ] The entry matches the shape in [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] Star count and license came from the GitHub API, not memory
- [ ] The portability line lists only clients whose manifest is actually in the source repo
- [ ] The sign-in line reflects what actually happens on install, or says it could not be established
- [ ] Not already listed, and it is in the right category

Format nits get fixed on merge. Do not let one hold the PR up.
